title: Concept: pnpm permits install scripts for specific packages
description: pnpm-lock.yaml declares an allowlist entry that lets a dependency run its build script, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The allowed package executes code with the build user's privileges before any review step, in exchange for a native build the project may not need.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pnpm-lock.yaml (npm).
risk: The allowed package executes code with the build user's privileges before any review step, in exchange for a native build the project may not need.
